operations.name: Mandrill post exports activity json
operations.description: Begins an export of your activity history. The activity will be exported to a zip archive containing a single file named activity.csv in the same format as you would be able to export from your account's activity view. It includes the following fields: Date, Email Address, Sender, Subject, Status, Tags, Opens, Clicks, Bounce Detail. If you have configured any custom metadata fields, they will be i

operations.name: Mandrill post exports info json
operations.description: Returns information about an export job. If the export job's state is 'complete', the returned data will include a URL you can use to fetch the results. Every export job produces a zip archive, but the format of the archive is distinct for each job type. The api calls that initiate exports include more details about the output format for that job type.

operations.name: Mandrill post exports list json
operations.description: Returns a list of your exports.

operations.name: Mandrill post exports rejects json
operations.description: Begins an export of your rejection blacklist. The blacklist will be exported to a zip archive containing a single file named rejects.csv that includes the following fields: email, reason, detail, created_at, expires_at, last_event_at, expires_at.

operations.name: Mandrill post exports whitelist json
operations.description: Begins an export of your rejection whitelist. The whitelist will be exported to a zip archive containing a single file named whitelist.csv that includes the following fields: email, detail, created_at.

operations.name: Mandrill post inbound add domain json
operations.description: Add an inbound domain to your account

operations.name: Mandrill post inbound add route json
operations.description: Add a new mailbox route to an inbound domain

operations.name: Mandrill post inbound check domain json
operations.description: Check the MX settings for an inbound domain. The domain must have already been added with the add-domain call

operations.name: Mandrill post inbound delete domain json
operations.description: Delete an inbound domain from the account. All mail will stop routing for this domain immediately.

operations.name: Mandrill post inbound delete route json
operations.description: Delete an existing inbound mailbox route

operations.name: Mandrill post inbound domains json
operations.description: List the domains that have been configured for inbound delivery

operations.name: Mandrill post inbound routes json
operations.description: List the mailbox routes defined for an inbound domain

operations.name: Mandrill post inbound send raw json
operations.description: Take a raw MIME document destined for a domain with inbound domains set up, and send it to the inbound hook exactly as if it had been sent over SMTP

operations.name: Mandrill post inbound update route json
operations.description: Update the pattern or webhook of an existing inbound mailbox route. If null is provided for any fields, the values will remain unchanged.

operations.name: Mandrill post ips cancel warmup json
operations.description: Cancels the warmup process for a dedicated IP.

operations.name: Mandrill post ips check custom dns json
operations.description: Tests whether a domain name is valid for use as the custom reverse DNS for a dedicated IP.

operations.name: Mandrill post ips create pool json
operations.description: Creates a pool and returns it. If a pool already exists with this name, no action will be performed.

operations.name: Mandrill post ips delete json
operations.description: Deletes a dedicated IP. This is permanent and cannot be undone.

operations.name: Mandrill post ips delete pool json
operations.description: Deletes a pool. A pool must be empty before you can delete it, and you cannot delete your default pool.

operations.name: Mandrill post ips info json
operations.description: Retrieves information about a single dedicated ip.

operations.name: Mandrill post ips list json
operations.description: Lists your dedicated IPs.

operations.name: Mandrill post ips list pools json
operations.description: Lists your dedicated IP pools.

operations.name: Mandrill post ips pool info json
operations.description: Describes a single dedicated IP pool.

operations.name: Mandrill post ips provision json
operations.description: Requests an additional dedicated IP for your account. Accounts may have one outstanding request at any time, and provisioning requests are processed within 24 hours.

operations.name: Mandrill post ips set custom dns json
operations.description: Configures the custom DNS name for a dedicated IP.

operations.name: Mandrill post ips set pool json
operations.description: Moves a dedicated IP to a different pool.

operations.name: Mandrill post ips start warmup json
operations.description: Begins the warmup process for a dedicated IP. During the warmup process, Mandrill will gradually increase the percentage of your mail that is sent over the warming-up IP, over a period of roughly 30 days. The rest of your mail will be sent over shared IPs or other dedicated IPs in the same pool.

operations.name: Mandrill post messages cancel scheduled json
operations.description: Cancels a scheduled email.

operations.name: Mandrill post messages content json
operations.description: Get the full content of a recently sent message

operations.name: Mandrill post messages info json
operations.description: Get the information for a single recently sent message

operations.name: Mandrill post messages list scheduled json
operations.description: Queries your scheduled emails by sender or recipient, or both.

operations.name: Mandrill post messages parse json
operations.description: Parse the full MIME document for an email message, returning the content of the message broken into its constituent pieces

operations.name: Mandrill post messages reschedule json
operations.description: Reschedules a scheduled email.

operations.name: Mandrill post messages search json
operations.description: Search the content of recently sent messages and optionally narrow by date range, tags and senders. This method may be called up to 20 times per minute. If you need the data more often, you can use /messages/info.json to get the information for a single message, or webhooks to push activity to your own application for querying.

operations.name: Mandrill post messages search time series json
operations.description: Search the content of recently sent messages and return the aggregated hourly stats for matching messages

operations.name: Mandrill post messages send json
operations.description: Send a new transactional message through Mandrill

operations.name: Mandrill post messages send raw json
operations.description: Take a raw MIME document for a message, and send it exactly as if it were sent through Mandrill's SMTP servers

operations.name: Mandrill post messages send template json
operations.description: Send a new transactional message through Mandrill using a template

operations.name: Mandrill post metadata add json
operations.description: Add a new custom metadata field to be indexed for the account.

operations.name: Mandrill post metadata delete json
operations.description: Delete an existing custom metadata field. Deletion isn't instataneous, and /metadata/list will continue to return the field until the asynchronous deletion process is complete.

operations.name: Mandrill post metadata list json
operations.description: Get the list of custom metadata fields indexed for the account.

operations.name: Mandrill post metadata update json
operations.description: Update an existing custom metadata field.

operations.name: Mandrill post rejects add json
operations.description: Adds an email to your email rejection blacklist. Addresses that you add manually will never expire and there is no reputation penalty for removing them from your blacklist. Attempting to blacklist an address that has been whitelisted will have no effect.

operations.name: Mandrill post rejects delete json
operations.description: Deletes an email rejection. There is no limit to how many rejections you can remove from your blacklist, but keep in mind that each deletion has an affect on your reputation.

operations.name: Mandrill post rejects list json
operations.description: Retrieves your email rejection blacklist. You can provide an email address to limit the results. Returns up to 1000 results. By default, entries that have expired are excluded from the results; set include_expired to true to include them.

operations.name: Mandrill post senders add domain json
operations.description: Adds a sender domain to your account. Sender domains are added automatically as you send, but you can use this call to add them ahead of time.

operations.name: Mandrill post senders check domain json
operations.description: Checks the SPF and DKIM settings for a domain. If you haven't already added this domain to your account, it will be added automatically.

operations.name: Mandrill post senders domains json
operations.description: Returns the sender domains that have been added to this account.

operations.name: Mandrill post senders info json
operations.description: Return more detailed information about a single sender, including aggregates of recent stats

operations.name: Mandrill post senders list json
operations.description: Return the senders that have tried to use this account.

operations.name: Mandrill post senders time series json
operations.description: Return the recent history (hourly stats for the last 30 days) for a sender

operations.name: Mandrill post senders verify domain json
operations.description: Sends a verification email in order to verify ownership of a domain. Domain verification is an optional step to confirm ownership of a domain. Once a domain has been verified in a Mandrill account, other accounts may not have their messages signed by that domain unless they also verify the domain. This prevents other Mandrill accounts from sending mail signed by your domain.

operations.name: Mandrill post subaccounts add json
operations.description: Add a new subaccount

operations.name: Mandrill post subaccounts delete json
operations.description: Delete an existing subaccount. Any email related to the subaccount will be saved, but stats will be removed and any future sending calls to this subaccount will fail.

operations.name: Mandrill post subaccounts info json
operations.description: Given the ID of an existing subaccount, return the data about it

operations.name: Mandrill post subaccounts list json
operations.description: Get the list of subaccounts defined for the account, optionally filtered by a prefix

operations.name: Mandrill post subaccounts pause json
operations.description: Pause a subaccount's sending. Any future emails delivered to this subaccount will be queued for a maximum of 3 days until the subaccount is resumed.

operations.name: Mandrill post subaccounts resume json
operations.description: Resume a paused subaccount's sending

operations.name: Mandrill post subaccounts update json
operations.description: Update an existing subaccount

operations.name: Mandrill post tags all time series json
operations.description: Return the recent history (hourly stats for the last 30 days) for all tags

operations.name: Mandrill post tags delete json
operations.description: Deletes a tag permanently. Deleting a tag removes the tag from any messages that have been sent, and also deletes the tag's stats. There is no way to undo this operation, so use it carefully.

operations.name: Mandrill post tags info json
operations.description: Return more detailed information about a single tag, including aggregates of recent stats

operations.name: Mandrill post tags list json
operations.description: Return all of the user-defined tag information

operations.name: Mandrill post tags time series json
operations.description: Return the recent history (hourly stats for the last 30 days) for a tag

operations.name: Mandrill post templates add json
operations.description: Add a new template

operations.name: Mandrill post templates delete json
operations.description: Delete a template

operations.name: Mandrill post templates info json
operations.description: Get the information for an existing template

operations.name: Mandrill post templates list json
operations.description: Return a list of all the templates available to this user

operations.name: Mandrill post templates publish json
operations.description: Publish the content for the template. Any new messages sent using this template will start using the content that was previously in draft.

operations.name: Mandrill post templates render json
operations.description: Inject content and optionally merge fields into a template, returning the HTML that results

operations.name: Mandrill post templates time series json
operations.description: Return the recent history (hourly stats for the last 30 days) for a template

operations.name: Mandrill post templates update json
operations.description: Update the code for an existing template. If null is provided for any fields, the values will remain unchanged.

operations.name: Mandrill post urls add tracking domain json
operations.description: Add a tracking domain to your account

operations.name: Mandrill post urls check tracking domain json
operations.description: Checks the CNAME settings for a tracking domain. The domain must have been added already with the add-tracking-domain call

operations.name: Mandrill post urls list json
operations.description: Get the 100 most clicked URLs

operations.name: Mandrill post urls search json
operations.description: Return the 100 most clicked URLs that match the search query given

operations.name: Mandrill post urls time series json
operations.description: Return the recent history (hourly stats for the last 30 days) for a url

operations.name: Mandrill post urls tracking domains json
operations.description: Get the list of tracking domains set up for this account

operations.name: Mandrill post users info json
operations.description: Return the information about the API-connected user

operations.name: Mandrill post users ping2 json
operations.description: Validate an API key and respond to a ping (anal JSON parser version)

operations.name: Mandrill post users ping json
operations.description: Validate an API key and respond to a ping

operations.name: Mandrill post users senders json
operations.description: Return the senders that have tried to use this account, both verified and unverified

operations.name: Mandrill post webhooks add json
operations.description: Add a new webhook

operations.name: Mandrill post webhooks delete json
operations.description: Delete an existing webhook

operations.name: Mandrill post webhooks info json
operations.description: Given the ID of an existing webhook, return the data about it

operations.name: Mandrill post webhooks list json
operations.description: Get the list of all webhooks defined on the account

operations.name: Mandrill post webhooks update json
operations.description: Update an existing webhook

operations.name: Mandrill post whitelists add json
operations.description: Adds an email to your email rejection whitelist. If the address is currently on your blacklist, that blacklist entry will be removed automatically.

operations.name: Mandrill post whitelists delete json
operations.description: Removes an email address from the whitelist.

operations.name: Mandrill post whitelists list json
operations.description: Retrieves your email rejection whitelist. You can provide an email address or search prefix to limit the results. Returns up to 1000 results.
